directMoveSignals.signal: New office address in job ads
directMoveSignals.reliability: Very High — company is advertising the location before officially announcing
directMoveSignals.action: Verify address, research building, reach out to office manager or CEO

directMoveSignals.reliability: Very High — confirmed move in progress
directMoveSignals.action: Comment congratulations + personalised DM with free layout plan offer within 24 hours

directMoveSignals.signal: Commercial property press release naming tenant
directMoveSignals.reliability: Very High — landlord/agent has confirmed the lease
directMoveSignals.action: Direct outreach to tenant contact within 48 hours

directMoveSignals.reliability: High — office has moved or is about to move
directMoveSignals.action: Reach out via new address — they may still need additional furniture for the new space

indirectMoveSignals.signal: Company approaching a lease renewal window (3, 5, or 7 years in current location)
indirectMoveSignals.reliability: Medium — they may renew and refresh, or relocate
indirectMoveSignals.approach: Offer workspace refresh assessment — either outcome creates a furniture opportunity

indirectMoveSignals.signal: Multiple job postings with 'hybrid work' or 'flexible workspace' language
indirectMoveSignals.reliability: Medium — suggests they are reconsidering office design
indirectMoveSignals.approach: Content-led outreach: 'How companies are redesigning for hybrid work' — not a hard pitch

indirectMoveSignals.signal: Negative Glassdoor/Indeed office reviews mentioning 'cramped space' or 'poor furniture'
indirectMoveSignals.reliability: Low-Medium — they are aware of the problem
indirectMoveSignals.approach: Sensitive approach required — 'we noticed your team values workspace quality'

brisbane.precinct: Inner city CBDs: Brisbane CBD, Fortitude Valley, South Brisbane, Newstead, Milton
majorDevelopments: Cross River Rail adjacent commercial precincts
brisbane.note: New major commercial precincts create waves of new tenants — monitor development completions 12 months ahead

sydney.precinct: CBD, North Sydney, Pyrmont, Parramatta, South Eveleigh
sydney.opportunity: Post-2024 return-to-office push driving significant fitout investment in Sydney CBD

melbourne.precinct: CBD, Docklands, Southbank, Richmond, Cremorne (tech precinct)
melbourne.opportunity: Cremorne tech precinct has consistent high-growth company turnover — strong target zone
